description: This file defines a Java interface 'MessageMapper' which specifies methods for mapping between ExternalMessage objects and Adaptable objects within a connectivity service. It includes configuration, mapping, retrieval of content types, and conditions for message transformation.

classes.name: MessageMapper
classes.description: An interface defining methods for mapping connectivity messages to and from the internal representation

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for this mapper

methods.name: getContentTypeBlocklist
methods.description: Retrieves content types that this mapper should not handle

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with provided settings

methods.name: map (ExternalMessage to Adaptable)
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage to a list of Adaptable objects

methods.name: map (Adaptable to ExternalMessage)
methods.description: Maps an Adaptable object to a list of ExternalMessage objects

methods.name: getDefaultOptions
methods.description: Provides default options for the mapper

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns conditions to be checked before processing incoming messages

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns conditions to be checked before processing outgoing messages

methods.name: findContentType (ExternalMessage)
methods.description: Retrieves the content-type header from an ExternalMessage

methods.name: findContentType (Adaptable)
methods.description: Retrieves the content-type header from an Adaptable object
